build_attention_module: build a PyTorch Attention module that computes additive attention weights over visual features using an RNN hidden state
build_attention2_module: build an Attention2 module with configurable region attention modes including additive, multiplicative, and dot-product variants
build_topdown_core: build a TopDownCore module that combines two LSTM cells with dual attention mechanisms for grounded video description
build_topdown_model: build a TopDownModel that wraps TopDownCore as a 2-layer attention-based language model for video captioning
review_attention_forward: review the Attention forward method to understand how softmax-weighted feature aggregation produces attention residuals
